# Wiqonn

> Applied AI research and engineering lab based in Barranquilla, Colombia. We
> research, adapt, train, evaluate and deploy custom AI systems for organizations
> of every size, anywhere in the world.

## Who we are

- Applied AI lab operated from Barranquilla, Colombia, working worldwide in Spanish and English.
- One team spans model research, data, evaluation, product engineering and production deployment.
- Full-stack coverage from raw data to cloud, on-premise, edge and embedded AI systems.
- We build, fine-tune and deploy AI on our own hardware: DGX Spark (Blackwell GB10) and Apple Silicon, keeping client data private and on-premise.

## What we do

- Custom and domain-specific models: we select, adapt, fine-tune or train models according to the problem, data and operating environment.
- Language and multimodal AI: LLMs, vision-language models, document intelligence, speech and private knowledge systems.
- Custom LLM fine-tuning: fine-tuning open models (e.g. SmolLM3-3B, Llama) with LoRA and 4-bit NVFP4/MXFP8 quantization on Blackwell GPUs.
- LLM/RAG applications: document Q&A, knowledge management, semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation in Spanish and English.
- Computer vision: defect detection, OCR/document processing, visual inspection, medical imaging.
- Forecasting and decision systems: predictive models, anomaly detection, recommendations, risk and optimization.
- Model evaluation and safety: domain evals, robustness, latency, inference cost, red teaming and guardrails.
- AI infrastructure and MLOps: data pipelines, model serving, monitoring, cloud, on-premise and edge deployment.
- AI product engineering: web and mobile apps, APIs and integration with existing systems.
- Agentic systems: tool-using and orchestrated workflows when that architecture fits the use case.

## Applied research

- Model evaluation with real data and academic rigor — we test claims before we ship.
- Benchmarks on local inference: vLLM-MLX on Apple Silicon (464 tok/s on M4 Max, 200+ models, zero API cost).
- Fine-tuning pipelines on DGX Spark: NVFP4 (E2M1) and MXFP8 training with Transformer Engine, TensorRT-LLM serving.
- We document model performance and limitations before recommending a larger implementation.

## How we work

- AI Opportunity & Feasibility Assessment (AI Readiness Audit): problem framing, data readiness, technical options, risks and a staged roadmap.
- Evidence-led validation: representative data, a baseline, acceptance criteria and clear decision gates before scaling.
- Managed AI Ops: managed operations, monitoring, retraining and model evolution with SLA.
- Fractional AI Leadership: AI direction and CTO-as-a-service.
- IP / White-Label: validated AI solutions licensed for integrators and consultancies.
- Scope, deliverables and price defined in writing for each phase, with no contractual lock-in.
